adjudication.rationale: In app/views/embed/loading.html.erb the script calls `setTimeout(function() { document.location.reload(); }, 30000);`. While it only schedules one reload per page load, each reload re-renders the same template (when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` is still nil in `EmbedController#best`) and re-schedules another reload, resulting in indefinite 30s polling if the import never succeeds. The diff shows no attempt counter, backoff, or terminal failure UI/behavior.
